text: Joshua Wong sentenced to 10 more years in Hong Kong prison. Joshua Wong is trending after a Hong Kong court on Thursday, Nov. 5, sentenced him to 10 more years in prison for a second national security conviction. The ruling came two months before he was due to be released, and BBC reported two months of the term will run concurrently with his current sentence.. Wong first drew international attention as a leader of the 2014 Umbrella Movement protests. He was later jailed in Hong Kong for earlier protest-related convictions, including a 2021 sentence for a Tiananmen vigil. His first national security conviction came in 2024, when he received four years and eight months over an unofficial primary vote for opposition candidates. In June 2025 he was charged again, this time with conspiring with exiled activist Nathan Law to ask foreign governments for sanctions. He pleaded guilty to that charge on Sept. 2, 2026. Amnesty International said the timing of the new charge was designed to add to his time in prison; that is the group's view, not a court finding.. Joshua Wong, once the teenage face of Hong Kong's democracy movement, was sentenced on Thursday to 10 years in prison. The sentence came over a second conviction under the national security law that Beijing imposed on Hong Kong in 2020. Wong turned 30 last month and had already been jailed for subversion in 2024. Prosecutors said Wong conspired with other activists to lobby foreign governments, including the United States, to sanction China and Hong Kong in 2020. Wong pleaded guilty to the charge in September. Judge William Tam called the case grave and said the punishment must fit the crime. Human Rights Watch called the ruling cruel and unjust. Wong's friend Frances Hui, who lives in the United States, called the verdict outrageous.

Kimmel mocks Trump as Democrats win midterm election results. Jimmy Kimmel Live is trending after the host opened his show on the night of the midterm elections with jokes about the results, which favored Democrats. Kimmel's monologue drew wide coverage the next day, including a joke about the president's dipping sauce containers.. Jimmy Kimmel, the host of the ABC late-night program, spoke about the midterm election results on his show as they came in. He called the Democratic gains a blue tsunami and said Republicans' chances of keeping the House were slim, comparing the odds to rolling a 20 on a 20-sided die, a line he attributed to a Harvard election model. Kimmel also praised Democratic wins in key races, including Jon Ossoff's re-election to his Georgia Senate seat and James Talarico's win in the Texas Senate race. He said Talarico's win broke a 38-year drought for Democrats in Texas. Kimmel's remarks also took aim at President Donald Trump, whose reported anger on election night he joked about. Several outlets, including The New York Times and USA Today, also covered the monologue.

When is cyber monday: Nov. 30, 2026, the Monday after Thanksgiving. Cyber Monday 2026 falls on Monday, November 30. It is the online shopping day that follows Thanksgiving in the United States, and retailers use it to promote web sales.. Black Friday falls on November 27 this year, and retailers have started early holiday sales, including three Walmart events, so shoppers are already looking ahead to Cyber Monday.. Cyber Monday is a retail promotion term. Its date moves with Thanksgiving, so it falls between November 26 and December 2 depending on the year. It comes three days after Black Friday, which this year is November 27. On November 1, 2026, Adobe Analytics released its 2026 U.S. Holiday Shopping Forecast, projecting record online sales of $275.1 billion between November 1 and December 31. On November 2, an ABC News roundup listed early sales from several retailers. Target is running a three-day Early Black Friday Sale from November 5 through 7, with new weekly deals after that. Walmart published its holiday event schedule on October 26, 2026. It lists three major shopping events running from November 12 through December 2. Shoppers are starting earlier this year, so many deals are already live ahead of November 30.

What was the Umbrella Movement: 2014 Hong Kong protests. The Umbrella Movement was a political movement in Hong Kong that began in 2014, when protesters demanded genuine democratic elections for the city's chief executive. Protesters used umbrellas to shield themselves from police pepper spray, which gave the movement its name.. Joshua Wong, a leading figure of the 2014 protests, was sentenced to 10 more years in prison in a Hong Kong court on Thursday, November 5, 2026, over a second conviction under the national security law.. The movement was triggered on 31 August 2014, when the Standing Committee of China's National People's Congress decided that candidates for the 2017 election of Hong Kong's chief executive would be pre-screened. Critics said this limited voters to choosing from candidates Beijing approved. Joshua Wong, then a teenager, rose to international prominence as one of its leading figures. The protests gave way to a wider pro-democracy movement in 2019, which led Beijing to impose its National Security Law on Hong Kong in 2020. Wong was sentenced on Thursday, November 5, 2026, to 10 years in prison over a second national security conviction, a term that extends the jail time he was already serving.

Who is Darius Acuff Jr.? Sacramento Kings rookie guard, 2026 draft. Darius Acuff Jr. Is a professional basketball point guard for the Sacramento Kings, a rookie who was drafted seventh overall in the 2026 NBA Draft. He played college basketball at Arkansas. He is known for scoring and passing early in his NBA career.. Acuff scored 34 points with 14 assists in a loss to the New Orleans Pelicans, a performance that placed him among rare company in NBA history, and his rookie season has drawn wide attention.. Darius Acuff Jr. Is a guard for the Sacramento Kings of the National Basketball Association (NBA). The Kings selected him seventh in the 2026 NBA Draft, the annual event where teams pick newly eligible players. Before turning professional, he played college basketball at the University of Arkansas. He came up through IMG Academy, a sports school in Florida, before his college years. Acuff is 19 years old and is a rookie, meaning this is his first season in the league. In his early games he has drawn attention for his scoring and passing. On a Thursday night in late October 2026, he scored 34 points and recorded 14 assists in a 132-120 loss to the New Orleans Pelicans. The performance placed him among a small group of teenagers in NBA history with 30 points and 10 assists in one game, a group that includes LeBron James and Luka Doncic. Other coverage has compared his style to that of Allen Iverson. Acuff also has a footwear deal with Reebok. The company released a player-exclusive colorway of its Engine A basketball shoe on Friday, October 21, 2026, priced at $120 in adult sizes on Reebok.com. Reebok has also revealed his signature logo, and a first signature shoe is planned. The Kings had not won through their first five games of the season. Why it matters now: Acuff's early numbers and highlights have drawn wide attention around the league. Preseason and early-season performances of rookies such as Acuff are a common topic when fans and analysts judge which new players are standing out.
